links.comparator_used: P1 zero-shot natural language prompt (and P2 structured sections with local checks)
links.outcome: Total Score and Full Accuracy on five dental image-interpretation variables vs radiology report
links.effect: Mean Total Score 3.47 ± 1.33 (P1) to 4.77 ± 0.68 (P3 HRG); Full Accuracy 23.3% to 86.7%; failures involving three or more variables 20.0% to 3.3%; significant differences for Tooth Number, Tooth Angulation, Anatomical Relationship
links.quote: Mean Total Score increased from 3.47 ± 1.33 for P1 to 4.77 ± 0.68 for P3, while Full Accuracy increased from 23.3% to 86.7%.
